## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish personal-finance interview podcast (Børsen's 'Sådan investerer jeg', sponsored by Saxo Bank) with entrepreneur Solama Ghorani. It covers her difficult childhood, her views on risk, her 'fuck you' savings account (about one year's expenses), courses as an investment in herself, owning versus renting property, and selling her AI startup HappyO to an undisclosed US company. No listed stocks are discussed as investment ideas. Listed companies only come up in passing, as anecdotes or examples.
